verses.en: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.sm: Isaraelu e, ia outou faalogologo mai i le afioga a le ALII; auā o loo i le ALII le finauga ma e o nonofo i le nuu; aua e leai se faamaoni, e leai se alofa, e leai foi se na te iloa le Atua i le nuu.

verses.en: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.sm: O loo tauto, ma tala pepelo, ma fasioti tagata, ma gaoi, ma mulilua, ua latou faasaua lava, ua fepaiaʻi toto.

verses.en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e faanoanoa ai le nuu, e tauau ina vaivai o i latou uma o e nonofo ai; atoa ma manu vaefa, ma manu felelei, e mavae atu foi lava o iʻa o le sami.

verses.en: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.sm: A e aua neʻi i ai se tagata e finau atu, ma aoai atu i se tasi tagata; auā o lou nuu ua pei o e fefinauai ma le ositaulaga.

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.sm: O lea e te paŭ ai i le ao, e pauu foi le perofeta faatasi ma oe i le po; ou te fasioti foi lou tinā.

verses.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
verses.sm: Ua faaumatia loʻu nuu ina ua leai se poto; o oe foi na e tetee atu i le poto, o le mea lea ou te tetee atu ai ia te oe, e le fai oe ma ositaulaga ia te au; ua e faagalogalo le tulafono a lou Atua, o aʻu foi, ou te faagalogalo i lau fanau.

verses.en: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
verses.sm: E pei ona faatoateleina o i latou, ua faapea ona agasala mai o i latou ia te au; ou te liliu ile mā lo latou mamalu.

verses.en: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.sm: Ua latou aai le agasala a loʻu nuu, ma ua latou naunau i lo latou leaga.

verses.en: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.sm: E oo ina gatusa lava o le nuu ma le ositaulaga; ou te taui atu foi ia te i latou a latou amio, ou te taui foi ia te i latou a latou mea ua fai.

verses.en: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua latou te aai, a e le maoona; e faitaaga i latou, a e le faatoateleina; aua ua le toe usiusitai i latou i le ALII.

verses.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.sm: O le faitaaga, ma le uaina, ma le uaina fou e aveeseina ai le loto.

verses.en: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.
verses.sm: O loʻu nuu ua latou fesili i lo latou laau; ua faasino mai ai lo latou tootoo ia te i latou; aua o le fia faitaaga ua faaseseina ai i latou, ma ua latou o ese nai lo latou Atua e faitaaga ai.

verses.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.sm: Ua latou faitaulaga i tumutumu o mauga, ma faamu mea manogi i mea maupuepue, ma lalo ifo o aluna, ma lipeno, ma tapeneto, auà ua lelei lo latou paolo; o le mea lea e faitaaga ai o outou afafine, e mulilulua foi a outou aya.

verses.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
verses.sm: Ou te le faasalaina o outou afafine pe a latou faitaaga, ma a outou ava pe a latou mulilulua; aua o i latou lava ua latou o ese faatasi ma fafine faitaaga, ua latou faitaulaga faatasi ma fafine talitane; o le nuu foi ua le mafaufau e pauu i latou.

verses.en: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
verses.sm: Isaraelu e, e ui ina e faitaaga, a e aua neʻi agasala Iuta; aua tou te o mai i Kilikala, aua tou te o ae i Petavene, aua foi tou te tauto, O loo soifua le An.

verses.en: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.sm: Aua e faapei ona vaogata o se povi fafine taanoa, ua faapea ona vaogata o Isaraelu; a e fagaina i latou i nei ona po e le ALII e faapei o se tamai mamoe i le mea lautele.

verses.en: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.sm: Ua pipii Efaraima i tupua; ina tuu ai pea ia ia te ia.

verses.en: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
verses.sm: A uma lo latou inuga‘ava, ua matuā faitaaga i latou; ua loto atu o latou alii i mea e masiasi ai.

verses.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.sm: Ua saisaitia o ia e le matagi i ona apaau, E masiasi foi i latou ona o a latou taulaga. O le toasa o le
